identitySignals: The agenda names 'Tides Center' as the fiscal sponsor and legal payee. A registered nonprofit named Tides Center exists in San Francisco, CA (ProPublica, EIN 94-3213100).
NGLC's own news page says Tides Center is its fiscal sponsor, so Tides Center is the legal entity behind the 'Next Generation Learning Challenges' grant.
NGLC has run school-redesign grant programs in Oakland (EdSurge, 'Oakland Goes Next Gen'). This fits an OUSD Linked Learning grant, but no page links the two directly.
The OUSD funding source is listed as 'Tides Center Grant', which matches the Tides Center name.
research.notes: The agenda vendor is a project (NGLC) fiscally sponsored by Tides Center. The profile describes Tides Center, the legal contracting entity, not NGLC itself. NGLC announced a merger with LEAP Innovations (Chicago) in early 2026, and nextgenlearning.org now shows LEAP content. I did not verify whether Tides still sponsors NGLC, so a reviewer should decide whether to show Tides Center or NGLC. The California Secretary of State entity number, SAM UEI and a general email were not found, so they are null.

profile.summary: Tides Center is a San Francisco nonprofit (501(c)(3)) that serves as a fiscal sponsor. It legally hosts and manages funds and administration for outside projects, including Next Generation Learning Challenges (NGLC), an education-innovation program that has funded school redesign work.
